items.title: NVR (NYSE:NVR) Misses Q2 CY2026 Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Homebuilder NVR (NYSE:NVR) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales falling 12.3% year on year to $2.28 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $83.96 per share was 6.7% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
